title: Returns portal for a furniture retailer
brief_text:
Project: returns portal for an online furniture retailer.
- Customers start a return on our website by entering their order number and email.
- Each return goes through requested, approved, picked up and refunded states.
- Warehouse staff approve or reject returns after inspecting photos uploaded by the customer.
- Refunds are issued automatically through Stripe once the item is received.
- Book the pickup with our courier through their API.
- Customers get an email at every status change.
- We'd love a dashboard showing return reasons by product, if there's time.
- Support agents can search returns by customer name, order number or date.
- Down the line we may want to plug this into our ERP.
- Single sign-on with our Microsoft accounts for staff.
- Export the monthly refunds list to CSV for finance.
- Not sure yet whether we need a mobile app for the drivers.
expected_confirmed_quotes: requested, approved, picked up and refunded
